**Finding: Compliant** (no redline).

Section 19 satisfies the preferred WARRANTY position on every material term:

- **19.1** — professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel per industry standards, plus material conformity of Services and Deliverables to documentation/specifications.
- **19.2** — 90 days post-delivery/acceptance for Deliverables, and Hosted Services conform *throughout the subscription term*, which is better than the 12-month software benchmark.
- **19.3** — no malicious code and compliance with Applicable Law, plus anti-degradation and open-source protections.
- **19.4** — real remedy ladder: re-perform/repair/replace at no charge, then termination and refund of Fees paid; expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
- **19.5** — disclaimer is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and carved back so it cannot swallow the express warranties, SLAs, indemnities or other remedies.

Section 6.2 further backs this with correction cycles and a refund right on Deliverable rejection. Nothing here requires a change.
